title: Necromancer's Ritual
description: A man in a black suit and red shirt kneels in a dark graveyard holding a glowing skull with flames. A large melting purple and yellow hot air balloon with a basket floats above, casting a beam of light, while a shadowy silhouetted figure stands to the right.
prompt: A man in a black suit kneels in a gothic graveyard at night holding a flaming skull that emits light, surrounded by crosses, candles, skulls and blood on the ground. A giant melting purple and yellow hot air balloon with a dripping texture and wooden basket floats above, casting a dramatic beam of light onto the man. A dark shadowy figure with glowing eyes stands in the background, dark cloudy sky, highly detailed dark fantasy surreal scene
